name: aivexus-local-desktop-readonly
description: Private, Windows desktop-only read-only status bridge for the running local AIVEXUS instance.

interface.longDescription: Read only the version, selected model, and runtime status of an AIVEXUS instance running on the same Windows PC. Uses a private local loopback connection, no tunnel, no cloud model API, and exposes one tool.
interface.defaultPrompt: Usa solo instance_info per mostrare versione AIVEXUS, modello selezionato e stato del runtime. Non avviare test.
